Aye Paighambar! Jab tum log auraton ko talaaq do to inhein iddat ke hisaab se talaaq do aur phir iddat ka hisaab rakho, aur Allah se darte raho ke woh tumhaara Parwardigar hai. Aur khabardaar inhein un ke gharon se mat nikaalna aur na woh khud niklein jab tak koi khula hua gunaah na karein. Yeh Khudaai hudood hain, aur jo Khudaai hudood se tajaawuz karega us ne apne hi nafs par zulm kiya hai. Tumhein nahin maaloom ke shaayad Khuda us ke baad koi nayi baat eejaad kar de

Phir jab woh apni muddat ko poora kar lein to inhein neki ke saath rok lo ya neki hi ke saath rukhsat kar do, aur talaaq ke liye apne mein se do aadil afraad ko gawaah banaao, aur gawaahi ko sirf Khuda ke liye qaaim karo. Naseehat un logon ko ki ja rahi hai jo Khuda aur roz-e-aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain, aur jo bhi Allah se darta hai Allah us ke liye najaat ki raah paida kar deta hai

Aur use aisi jagah se rizq deta hai jis ka khayaal bhi nahin hota hai, aur jo Khuda par bharosa karega Khuda us ke liye kaafi hai. Beshak Khuda apne hukm ka pahunchaane waala hai, us ne har shai ke liye ek miqdaar mu'ayyan kar di hai

Aur tumhaari auraton mein jo haiz se maayoos ho chuki hain agar un ke yaa'isa hone mein shak ho to un ka idda teen maheene hai, aur isi tarah woh auratein jin ke yahaan haiz nahin aata hai. Aur haamila auraton ka idda waz'-e-haml tak hai, aur jo Khuda se darta hai Khuda us ke amr mein aasaani paida kar deta hai
Yeh hukm-e-Khuda hai jise tumhaari taraf us ne naazil kiya hai, aur jo Khuda se darta hai Khuda us ki buraaiyon ko door kar deta hai aur us ke ajr mein izaafa kar deta hai

Aur in mutallaqaat ko sukoonat do jaisi taaqat tum rakhte ho, aur inhein aziyyat mat do ke is tarah un par tangi karo. Aur agar haamila hon to un par us waqt tak infaaq karo jab tak waz'-e-haml na ho jaaye. Phir agar woh tumhaare bachchon ko doodh pilaayein to inhein un ki ujrat do aur use aapas mein neki ke saath tai karo, aur agar aapas mein kashaakash ho jaaye to doosri aurat ko doodh pilaane ka mauqa do

Saahib-e-wus'at ko chaahiye ke apni wus'at ke mutaabiq kharch kare, aur jis ke rizq mein tangi hai woh usi mein se kharch kare jo Khuda ne use diya hai, ke Khuda kisi nafs ko us se zyaada takleef nahin deta hai jitna use ata kiya gaya hai. Anqareeb Khuda tangi ke baad wus'at ata kar dega
Aur kitni hi bastiyaan hain jinhon ne hukm-e-Khuda o Rasool ki naafarmaani ki to hum ne un ka shadeed muhaasaba kar liya aur inhein badtareen azaab mein mubtala kar diya
Phir unhon ne apne kaam ke wabaal ka maza chakh liya aur aakhri anjaam khasaara hi qaraar paaya
Allah ne un ke liye shadeed qism ka azaab muhayya kar rakha hai. Lihaaza imaan waalo aur aql waalo! Allah se daro ke us ne tumhaari taraf apne zikr ko naazil kiya hai

Woh Rasool jo Allah ki waazeh aayaat ki tilaawat karta hai ke imaan aur nek amal karne waalon ko taareekiyon se nikaal kar noor ki taraf le aaye. Aur jo Khuda par imaan rakhega aur nek amal karega Khuda use un jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, woh unhi mein hamesha rehne waale hain, aur Allah ne inhein yeh behtareen rizq ata kiya hai

Allah hi woh hai jis ne saaton aasmaanon ko paida kiya hai aur zameenon mein bhi waisi hi zameenein banaayi hain. Us ke ahkaam un ke darmiyaan naazil hote rehte hain taake tumhein yeh maaloom rahe ke woh har shai par qaadir hai aur us ka ilm tamaam ashya ko muheet hai
